meta.goal: use visual effects only when they improve analysis efficiency

rules: effects must clarify hierarchy, focus or state
effects must not compete with dense data reading
all non-essential motion should degrade cleanly
background ambience must stay subordinate to foreground content

css.why: lowest cost, best maintainability, and sufficient for most shell and component interactions
constraints: prefer opacity, transform and color transitions

svg.why: crisp rendering and semantic control for lightweight analytical graphics
constraints: keep path counts low in dense views
do not use SVG for the main high-density timeline layer

recommended_for: selection overlays with hybrid DOM controls
canvas.why: better suited than DOM or SVG for rendering many timeline events without overwhelming layout and paint
constraints: pair with text overlays only where necessary
must provide textual summaries for selected ranges
must support reduced-motion and lower-detail rendering
fallback: freeze animation during continuous zoom or pan

recommended_for: extreme-scale trace sessions where Canvas cannot sustain interaction goals
webgl.why: can unlock larger draw volumes, but adds implementation complexity and debugging cost
do_not_use_when: MVP data sizes are already smooth with Canvas and virtualization
team lacks evidence of rendering bottleneck
accessibility and fallback path are not ready
entry_criteria: measured frame drops during real trace zoom and pan
fallback to Canvas or aggregated view exists

p5.why: best for expressive generative visuals, not for structured devtools analysis surfaces
avoid_because: adds a creative-coding layer with little diagnostic value
risks introducing decorative motion unrelated to evidence discovery

ambient_effects.usage: subtle top-edge highlight on elevated panels
very slight tonal separation between shell regions

interactive_effects.usage: table and bottleneck list hover or selection
timeline selected range fill and stroke

status_effects.usage: brief value update emphasis on metrics
status_effects.notes: use only on real-time or refreshed values

status_effects.usage: highlight linked evidence after apply action

rules: disable panel slide distance and use opacity-only reveals
turn chart and metric transitions into instant state changes
keep timeline navigation functional without animated interpolation
no perpetual decorative animation in the main workspace
no large blurred layers behind dense tables or timeline
no WebGL without a measured need and a fallback
dense data views should prioritize redraw stability over visual flourish
preferred_measurements: zoom and pan responsiveness in timeline
table scroll smoothness at 10k plus rows
sidebar open latency under active data load
